title: Juice or Water? A Mixing Puzzle | AMC 8-Style Level 4
description:
Ella adds juice AND water to a drink, but the question only asks about the water. Vantee splits each drink into juice and water, shows a faster way that follows only the water, explains why each wrong answer is tempting, and gives you a sneakier mix to try yourself.
